info.name: FullStory Export Batch Import Segments API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of segments to return per page. Default is 20, maximum is 100.

params.name: pagination_token
params.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results. Do not change other list parameters between consecutive paginated requests.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of segments for the organization. You can optionally limit the number of segments returned, with a default of 20 and a maximum of 100 per page. Use the pagination token to retrieve additional pages of results.

params.name: segmentId
params.description: The unique identifier for the segment

items.docs: Returns segment information for the provided segment ID, including the segment name, creator email, and creation timestamp.
